summary: A free pixel monospace staged as a retro-futurist space mission: a glitching wordmark over a collage of mission paperwork, a departures board, boarding-pass ephemera, editable sample lines labelled with size and tracking, a cockpit HUD that turns the page from light to dark, a glyph inspector with metric card, use-case panels (box-drawing diagrams, Rust/SQL code, an editable mission report on tractor-feed paper) and a playable Arkanoid clone. Each section is introduced by a small '░' comment caption.

instances.look: Top-left wordmark 'DEPARTURƎ_MOƝO' in pixel caps on a grey selection-like bar with a tiny 'v1.500'; top-right '↓ DOWNLOAD / > GITHUB / ♥ DONATE'; below, a collage of mission paperwork: a Mercury Research Labs letter to 'Dr. Kerning' with sage-highlighted lines, a tan 'EVIDENCE OF GEOTHERMAL ACTIVITY ON NEWLY DISCOVERED KBOS' clipping with a QR-like pixel block and paperclip, a dark access badge '2 0 7 … E. Kerning', a line-drawn highlighter and planet construction circles
instances.ux: Loader shows a grey bar, then the title appears and glitches letters into look-alikes (E→Ǝ/3, N→Ɲ, O→0); collage pieces shift with scroll; side caption '░ DEPARTURE MONO IS A MONOSPACED PIXEL FONT WITH A LO-FI TECHNICAL VIBE'
instances.learn: Glitch the wordmark between look-alike glyphs of the font itself: the name animates without any extra artwork

reconstruction.layout: Light #eeeeee page; wordmark ~780×76px at x=44, y≈140 on a #d3d3d2 bar; link stack top-right at x≈1270; collage from y≈400: letter ~940px wide at x≈500 (cropped right), clipping ~380px rotated on top-right, badge ~260×540px at x≈0 partly offscreen, highlighter ~660px line drawing at y≈1220, planet circles behind
reconstruction.typography: Wordmark ~80px Departure Mono uppercase with underscore; version ~9px; links ~11px uppercase with ↓ › ♥ glyphs; letter body ~14px; clipping headline ~24px uppercase; captions ~8px uppercase with '░' prefix
reconstruction.behaviour: Intro: dark → grey placeholder bar (~1.5s) → title; title characters periodically swap to alternate/look-alike glyphs; collage items (#planet, #brief, #newspaper-clipping, #badge, #highlighter) move at different scroll rates
reconstruction.content: Fictional mission to the Kuiper belt: letter from Mercury Research Labs, Farnsworth Research Institute clipping, crew badge for E. Kerning
reconstruction.assets: SVG props: planet.svg, brief.svg, newspaper-clipping.svg, paperclip.svg, badge.svg, highlighter-outline.svg
reconstruction.html: h1#title with #title-space-dyn / #title-space-sta; #version; links to ZIP, GitHub releases, buymeacoffee; img#planet, #brief, #newspaper-clipping, #paperclip, #badge, #highlighter

instances.look: Three stacked micro-links at the top right: '↓ DOWNLOAD', '> GITHUB', '♥ DONATE'; the OFL licence is named only in the footer and HUD
instances.ux: Download is a direct ZIP (DepartureMono-1.500.zip); GitHub opens the latest release; Donate goes to Buy Me a Coffee
instances.learn: Use the font's own arrow and heart glyphs as button icons: the CTA doubles as a glyph sample

reconstruction.layout: Vertical stack of 3 links, ~18px line pitch, right-aligned block at x≈1270, y≈150

instances.look: Panels per use case, each tagged by a tiny '░' comment: a departures board in box-drawing characters ('Destination ↑ | Departing | Gate | Status', KBA Kuiper Alpha row highlighted sage) with '░ IT'S GREAT FOR WORKING WITH TABULAR DATA'; on dark, a TCP header bit diagram and a full keyboard drawn in box-drawing lines ('░ INCLUDED: BOX DRAWING CHARACTERS FOR YOUR PSEUDO-GRAPHICAL NEEDS'); Rust code with orange types, a huge SQL 'SELECT mission_… FROM gamma_bl…', a labelled Mercury-capsule line drawing and an orange pixel countdown '14' ('░ ADD A RETRO FLAVOR TO YOUR CODE AND TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION')
instances.ux: The board row blinks; the countdown ticks down; panels are otherwise static
instances.learn: Caption each sample with the job it proves (tables, box drawing, code, docs) as a code comment: the showcase reads like a feature list

reconstruction.layout: Table: full-width pre (#departures) ~1500px wide, cropped right, rows ~56px, at y≈1490 in block 00; box drawing: TCP diagram ~450px at x≈50 and keyboard ~820px at x≈620 cropped right; code: Rust block from x≈800, SQL ~45px at the bottom-left, drawing ~600px behind the countdown at x≈0–620; captions ~8px with a 4px vertical bar to the left

reconstruction.content: In-world data: departures to Europa 1, Kuiper Alpha, Mars Landing, New Tokyo, Zvezda Moonbase; a TCP header; a LifeSupport Rust struct; SQL on mission tables; Mercury capsule parts list

instances.look: Four editable lines at falling sizes, each under a tiny label row 'DEPARTURE MONO · 121PX · -11PX TRACK': 'ATTN: PASSENGERS QUIET IN THE CABIN', 'FLIGHT ATTENDANTS, PREPARE FOR TAKEOFF', then the font description in caps at 22px and in sentence case at 16.5px

instances.learn: Label each sample with its px size and tracking: the specimen documents the settings that make a pixel font crisp (multiples of 11px)

instances.look: A cockpit HUD: 'EARTH TIME: 20:44:48:49' clocks, '|||||||| D E P A R T U R E   M O N O ||||||||' header, gauge bars (OMS He tank, N₂ tank, fuel %, H₂O %, hydraulic), a scrolling 'GLYPHS' counter 1182…1190 with 1186 bracketed, an attitude sphere with 'R 012 P 021 Y 130' and 'AUTO', an ACCEL ticker, and a fact row 'INITIATED: 2022 · LAUNCHED: 2024 · CLASSIFICATION: PIXEL MONOSPACED · LICENSE: SIL OFL'; drawn grey on light, then repeated orange on near-black

reconstruction.typography: All Departure Mono: header ~12px letter-spaced; counters ~22px; labels ~8–10px uppercase; values ~10px
reconstruction.behaviour: Live clock; tickers scroll their number columns; attitude values change; scroll-driven background/colour transition (#transition, #cockpit)
reconstruction.content: Fake telemetry plus real font facts (1186 glyphs, 2022/2024, SIL OFL)
reconstruction.assets: SVG HUD frame (sphere, brackets), gauges as divs

instances.look: On dark grey: a sticky light-grey card with a clipped corner showing the selected glyph ~300px tall in pixels ('LATIN CAPITAL LETTER Q', 'U+0051') across ruled metric lines labelled ASCENDER/CAP HEIGHT 400, X-HEIGHT 300, BASELINE 0, DESCENDER -100; on the right a long grid by category (Basic Latin, Extended Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Punctuation & Symbols, Numerals/Math/Currency, Graphical) with the active glyph boxed in orange
instances.ux: Hover or click a glyph to load it in the card with its Unicode name and code point; the card stays pinned while the ~8000px grid scrolls; faint technical diagrams sit behind
instances.learn: For a pixel font, show the selected glyph on its unit metrics (400/300/0/-100): the grid and the numbers explain the whole design

reconstruction.layout: Card ~500×660px at x≈35 (sticky, top-right corner clipped 45°); grid column from x≈620 to ~1110, 11 columns at ~60px, rows ~60px; category labels ~8px above each group; total ~8100px tall
reconstruction.typography: Card labels ~8px uppercase; preview glyph ~330px black; grid glyphs ~28px #c4c4c4; selected cell orange fill #f5a036 with black glyph
reconstruction.behaviour: Pointer over a cell → card updates name, code point and big glyph; orange highlight follows
reconstruction.content: Full character set (~1100 glyphs) including fractions, currency, arrows, music notes, block and box-drawing elements
reconstruction.html: #glyph-specimen (sticky card) + #glyph-specimen-static; grid of glyph cells by category
